title: Malicious code in @univerjs-pro/sheets-pivot-chart (npm)
description: The npm package @univerjs-pro/sheets-pivot-chart version 1.5.0 contains malicious code that can fully compromise any computer on which it is installed or running. The compromise may allow an attacker full control over the system, risking exposure of all stored secrets and keys. Immediate removal of the package and rotation of all secrets from a different machine is strongly advised.
